tha-ap99:1.1: vipine → vivane (sya-all) | vipine → vicane (bj: PTS) | Vipine → vivane (cck: syā. aṭṭha.)
tha-ap99:2.1: nibbutattaṁ → nibbutitaṁ (sya-all) | nibbutattaṁ → nibabutaṁ taṁ (bj: sī.selu) | Nibbutattaṁ → nibbutaggaṁ (cck: ka.); nibbūtikaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap99:3.1: mamāhu tāvade → me pāhunā tāva (sya-all) | āsi → mamāhu tāvade (bj: machasaṁ); me pāhuṇā tāva (bj: sīmu) | tāvade → vitti me pāhunā tāva (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap99:3.4: satthuno → satthuno siddhatthassa bhagavato vipapasannena cetasā (sya-all)
